prompt: Create an original 90 second acoustic minimalism instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: marimba, piano, muted strings. Style: phase-shifted repeating figures with small harmonic changes. Tempo approximately 112 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A cheerful and lively orchestral piece with a light, playful character. It features prominent piano melodies, pizzicato strings, and a blend of woodwind and brass sections, creating an upbeat and whimsical atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首欢快活泼的管弦乐曲，带有轻松俏皮的特点。它以突出的钢琴旋律、拨弦乐器以及木管和铜管乐器的融合为特色，营造出一种积极向上、异想天开的氛围。
